rows.name:
Here's a bit of gossip
I heard at the baths.

rows.label: tlk45500153_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Apparently His Majesty's Blade-sama
hasn't been seen around lately.

rows.label: tlk45500153_05_msg0003
rows.name:
Some say he was sent to assassinate
the Queen of Invidia, or married her
as a sign of friendship...

rows.label: tlk45500153_05_msg0004
rows.name: Rumors like that are flying around.
